People keep telling him the same thing: "Kevin, I have an energy vampire in my life."

He pushed back with one question: so this person has complete control over how you feel? The answer was always some version of yes — they're just too negative, too powerful, there's nothing you can do about it. So he actually looked up the clinical definition. An energy vampire, by the book, is someone who drains the emotional energy of others, leaving them exhausted and overwhelmed.

Sounds exactly right. Except for one detail nobody mentions.

Comment RISE and I'll send you what that detail is.

#subconscious #energy #awakening #consciousness #selfawareness #kevintrudeau

Before you name the energy vampire in your life, run the actual checklist.

Drama, and needing to be the center of attention. Victim mentality, blaming others for what's going wrong. Constantly needing validation, compliments, reassurance. Criticizing people. Making others feel small. And this is the one nobody sees coming — being charismatic, warm, the "life of the party," is on the list too.

Read that back honestly. Most people watching just found themselves on it at least once.

It's not an insult. It's information.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to actually use it.

#subconscious #selfawareness #awakening #consciousness #shadowwork #kevintrudeau

You're either at cause over your life, or at effect of it. There's no third option.

Picture two identical sailboats in the same storm. One has a sail and a rudder — the person on board can adjust and sail straight into the wind if they know how. The other has neither. Whatever the wind and the tide decide to do, that boat does. Most people are living in the second boat, getting pushed around by every external situation, and calling it their personality.

The boat was never the problem.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to build the rudder.

#subconscious #mindset #awakening #consciousness #manifestation #kevintrudeau

Zig Ziglar had a word for it decades ago: a SNIOP. Susceptible to the Negative Influence of Other People.

That's the actual reason energy vampires exist in your life — not because they're unusually powerful, but because you're unusually open. Stop being a SNIOP and the math changes completely: nobody can push a button you've already removed, and nothing they say can trigger a reaction that has nothing left inside to grab onto.

It was never about getting rid of the people. It was about removing the buttons.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how.

#subconscious #selfawareness #awakening #consciousness #mindset #kevintrudeau

Someone can say anything they want to you. Whether it lands is entirely up to you.

Picture sitting in a car during a total downpour — rain hammering the windshield, and you're completely dry. The storm is real. It's just not reaching you, because you're at cause over your own environment, not at the mercy of it. Negativity works exactly the same way once your energy field is big enough: people can pour it out all they want, and it simply never gets in.

You don't need everyone to stop raining. You need a bigger car.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to build one.

#subconscious #boundaries #awakening #consciousness #selfawareness #kevintrudeau

If a stranger knocked on your door holding a bag of rats and a bag of rotting garbage and asked to bring it inside, you would not say "come on in."

You'd say stop. Turn around. Get out. No hesitation, no debate about whether it's rude.

Yet most people let the energetic version happen constantly — someone's negativity, criticism, drama, walking straight into their head and taking up residence — because saying no out loud felt unkind. Your mind deserves the same door policy as your house.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to set it.

#subconscious #boundaries #awakening #consciousness #selfawareness #kevintrudeau

Personal power isn't a personality trait. It's built the same way, by the same four habits, for thousands of years.

Feed your mind with positive material daily, through audio. Feed it again, differently, through reading — it hits the brain through a separate pathway. Put yourself in rooms with motivated, positive people instead of avoiding them. And give and receive recognition freely, instead of starving for it or withholding it.

Do all four consistently and something shifts: energy vampires stop finding you. Not because you got lucky. Because you built the bubble.
